$comment: Every Part the pipeline builds. Adding a Part is adding an entry here, then running `bun run build`. Fixed models are converted from a STEP file; Cut Parts are generated in the browser and are described by a row spec that this pipeline verifies against the STEP file.

parts.name: V5 Smart Motor (11W)
notes: Mounting holes: four 8-32 tapped holes at the corners of each end face, at (±21.95, ±14) mm in the STEP frame, measured from the circle edges of the STEP file (3.4 mm, the 8-32 tap drill). Each runs about 12 mm in from its end, and the two ends are not joined. The old 2.2 mm bores 27 mm apart were not these holes.

The four holes are 43.9 mm apart along X and 28.0 mm along Y. Neither is a multiple of the channel web lattice (12.7 mm along, 6.35 mm across), so one channel web lines up with one of the four holes at a time. Others meet a channel only where a second channel or another placement takes them.

The output socket is a hand-placed opening at the top of the output boss, where the STEP 10.3 mm counterbore opens (manual). Its shafts are 1/8 in and 1/4 in square, per VEX knowledge base; the STEP does not show the square socket cleanly, so only the opening position and mouth are measured.

parts.name: V5 Smart Motor (5.5W)
notes: Mounting holes: two 8-32 tapped holes on the end face at STEP y = -40.13, at x = 0 and z = 3.15 and 15.85. They are 12.7 mm (0.5 in) apart, so both line up with one channel web row. Each runs about 19 mm in, to a shelf at y = -21.1. Measured from the STEP circle edges (3.45 mm, the 8-32 tap drill).
No other openings are measured on this motor yet. The 5.5 W STEP is 84 edges open in places, so only the end face holes are used.

parts.name: 5x15 Steel Plate
notes: Holes sit on a 0.25 in checkerboard lattice; half-holes on the outline are included. Opening size is the probe measurement, 4.5 mm square.

Budget miss, by design: each hole keeps four walls (8 triangles), 1,368 for 171 holes, and the faces around them need about 5 more each. Nothing collapses within 0.5 mm, so 1,200 cannot be reached without removing holes.
